debit.sms: To Block your Card, send SMS to 7045030000 by typing BLOCK CARD XXXX (Last 4 digits of card) from your registered mobile number.
debit.notes: Debit-card FAQ: block a lost/stolen/damaged card by calling the 24-hr phone banking centre at 1800 103 1222, or via internet banking (ib.equip.equitasbank.com/login), the Equitas 2.0 mobile app (Card Management: freeze, block, set limits) or a branch. +91-44-6965-4600 is the published line for calls from outside India; +91-44-4004-8500 is the international number for unauthorized-transaction queries. SMS BLOCK CARD works from the registered mobile number. For unauthorized transactions the bank also advises emailing unauthtrnx@equitas.bank.in and the national cybercrime helpline 1930. The bank's site now lives at equitas.bank.in (www.equitasbank.com redirects there).

credit.sms: To Block your Credit Card, send SMS to 7045030000 by typing BLOCK CC XXXX (Last 4 digits of card) from your registered mobile number.
credit.notes: Site-wide footer labels 1800-103-2977 'Loans/Credit Card related'; the credit-cards page contact module also publishes 'Call us at 1800 103 1222' and email customerservice@equitas.bank.in; no separate hours are stated for credit cards (the 1800 103 1222 line is published as 24-hr for banking). +91-44-6965-4600 for calls from outside India. SMS BLOCK CC works from the registered mobile number; report unauthorized card transactions to unauthtrnx@equitas.bank.in; the bank's page also advises the national cybercrime helpline 1930.
